bootstrap.method: paired circular moving blocks; sample weight equals snapshot multiplicity
bootstrap.multiplicity: 12 pointwise descriptive intervals; no confirmatory significance claims
bootstrap.seed_aggregation: mean AP of individual training seeds within each resample, not probability ensemble

calibration: reuse saved 32–33 Platt maps and raw/calibrated rules; never fit on test
drift_measures: training-quantile PSI (10 bins, unique cuts, 0.5 pseudocount), KS distance without naive p-values, Wasserstein/train SD
error_strata: step; in/out degree; weak component; confidence; fixed group comparisons; aggregate only

perturbations.edges: floor(severity*E) unique directed within-snapshot edges; nested selected positions
perturbations.evaluation: raw probabilities and saved raw F1 threshold; identical known-label populations
perturbations.mask: independent entry masking to known-training means before preprocessing; nested common uniforms
perturbations.noise: raw x + severity * known-training population SD * standard normal; shared 165-column fields
perturbations.precomputed_neighborhood_features: unchanged under edge changes; adjacency/feature inconsistency remains
perturbations.rewire: replace selected edges with unique non-self directed edges absent from original; preserve total E, not degrees
perturbations.scope: test snapshots 35–49 only; clean context 1–34; perturbed test summaries propagate to later context

shift_reference: steps 1–29 all observed nodes; known-training rows for preprocessing/noise scales
temporal_linear_head_limit: history adds snapshot-wide logit offset; no within-snapshot reranking at fixed weights
